Paragraph: Summary of Passage: Those who faithfully practice teachings aligned with divine order, free from envy and resentment, become liberated from the binding consequences of karma. Sincere execution of duty with trust in higher wisdom ensures steady progress toward spiritual liberation.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Understanding how regular people, who may not yet be completely flawless in their execution, can gain freedom from karmic entanglement.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna promises that anyone who follows His teachings with faith and without cynicism or envy (anasuyanto) will gradually break free from the bondage of fruitive actions.
Outcome/Resolution: Arjuna is reassured that sincere, un-envious alignment with duty brings ultimate liberation.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Faithful Alignment: Trusting a proven framework of values to guide daily choices
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Overcoming Cynicism: Releasing bitter judgment and skepticism to cultivate emotional openness
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Sincere Effort over Perfection: Focusing on honest engagement with growth rather than fearing mistakes

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Shraddhavanto 'nasuyanto (Acting with genuine faith and without envy or malice)
Mucyante te 'pi karmabhih (Becoming freed from the binding chains of karma)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Anyone who follows the Lord's instructions faithfully and without envy becomes liberated from the bondage of karma. Even if one's execution is initially imperfect, sincere adherence leads to spiritual perfection.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Approaching life's duties with trust and openness rather than cynicism or resentment reduces internal friction. Sincere commitment to positive values frees you from the emotional baggage of past errors.
